title: Document the Preview limits of the hosted board and the S3/DynamoDB backend, and close the gaps
description:
State 2026-10-19: of the three ways to run Kanbus (local files, files in the cloud, S3/DynamoDB) only local files is solid. The cloud console loses edits because the EFS working tree is not pushed back to git. The S3/DynamoDB backend is reachable only through kanbus-api. The kanb.us site labels the hosted board and the S3 backend as Preview.

Work: keep the Preview labels accurate on the site and in docs until each gap is closed; track the closing work against the story kbs-3bf858c6 (fresh EFS deployment trial, which must run on Ryan's M1 via Remote Control) and the open acceptance-review items kbs-d75be98d (import a board into S3 and rebuild the DynamoDB catalog) and kbs-fd3e4cb2 (concurrent edits produce git merge conflicts with no Kanbus way to resolve them).

Acceptance: each Preview label is either removed with evidence that the gap is closed, or still shown with the specific limitation named.
